summary: The bad() servlet entry point parses an attacker-controlled integer from the "name" request parameter and uses it as an index into a fixed 5-element array. The existing guard only checks the upper bound (data < array.length), leaving the lower bound unvalidated. A negative index (e.g. the Integer.MIN_VALUE initializer when parsing fails, or any negative user input) passes the check and causes an ArrayIndexOutOfBoundsException at array[data] — CWE-129 improper array index validation. The fix adds the missing lower-bound check (data >= 0) so the index must fall within the valid range before the array read. Legitimate indices 0–4 continue to work, invalid indices still take the "Array index out of bounds" branch, and the feature is preserved.
